quote: SLB has opened a Decommissioning Center of Excellence in Rio de Janeiro to support Brazil’s expanding offshore retirement activity… According to Petrobras, approximately 420 wells and about 2,000 kilometers of subsea pipelines and flexible lines are expected to be decommissioned by 2029… At the center’s inauguration, SLB and Petrobras introduced ROBIN, an autonomous subsea well intervention system developed in collaboration between the two companies.
note: Opened SLB 30 Jan 2026 English update; CapEx blank.
